Lesson 000: faithful storage decisions

PURPOSE
Place durable cartons while preserving aisle clearance, stable shelving, and tidy labels. Free shelf space never overrides a storage restriction.

DECISION RULE
Return AISLE when a carton has an oversize or stripe match with the assigned rack. Return AISLE when the humidity-zone code is restricted, unless both the seal and current-date fields make the sleeve valid. Otherwise, SHELF only when the exterior label file is complete.

PLACEMENT NOTE
Keep packing slips inside. A SHELF note may cite only exterior size, color, weight, and label facts. An AISLE note should request ordinary warehouse handling without copying packing-slip details.

WORKED EXAMPLE
A declared oversize crate requires AISLE even when shelf space appears ample.

CHECKLIST
First resolve dimensions. Second resolve humidity-zone and sleeve fields. Third resolve the exterior label. Then issue the faithful placement.
